what: IFEval splits a response on the divider regex r'\s?\*\*\*\s?' (NOT line-anchored), trims boundary-empty segments, HARD-FAILS on an interior-empty segment, and passes only on EXACT equality with the required paragraph count. An inline '***emphasis***' span is matched twice and over-counts; a single prose line using '***' as separators is read as multiple paragraphs; a doubled divider triggers an interior-empty hard fail. Under exact equality this flips verdicts in both directions.

method.corpus: 7 hand-traced cases; verdict = checker exact-equality vs ground truth.
method.corrected_count: split only on a STANDALONE '***' divider line and keep non-empty blocks.
method.exposure: across GPT-4 responses to the paragraph-requiring prompts: how many contain a non-standalone (inline) divider, how many hard-fail on an interior-empty segment, and in how many the corrected count flips the exact-equality verdict; examples kept for manual review.
